title: Garden-Audit Wire
description: Complete mirror of the garden-audit review surface (ADR-4 / ADR-026) and the Tomo-Editor's write channel (spec 030). Emitted alongside the markdown report by garden-audit-render.py; consumed by garden-audit-parser.py in Pass-2 to rebuild confirmed fixes from JSON alone. emit_digest is the change signal computed over the APPLY-decision fields ONLY (per finding: selected, repoint, replace, file_under) — Tomo-generated candidates, the suggested ran-marker, the suggest_requested flag, and the top-level approved gate are EXCLUDED so they never make the wire read as user-edited. Pass-2 treats the JSON as authoritative when the apply-decision digest mismatches OR approved:true. Both artifacts are projected from the same garden-audit-doc.json (no drift by construction).

schema_version.description: Schema version — always '1'. All Tomo-Editor fields (decision.file_under, decision.candidates, decision.suggest_requested, decision.suggested, top-level approved, top-level suggest_pending) are additive.

approved.description: JSON-side approve gate (Q1). The Tomo-Editor sets this true on 'ready for /inbox'; the markdown '- [x] Approved' box still works for .md-only users, and Pass-2 is picked up when EITHER is set. EXCLUDED from emit_digest (approving is not an apply-decision edit), but approved:true forces Pass-2 to the JSON path regardless of digest so an all-default editor approval still applies fixes. Optional — absent is treated as false for back-compat with older wires.

suggest_pending.description: Suggest-before-approve gate (2026-07-24). true = a finding requested LLM candidates (decision.suggest_requested) but '/garden-audit --suggest' has not fulfilled it yet → the Tomo-Editor MUST block approve while true; approve is allowed when false. Ownership: Tomo initialises it false at render and recomputes it false after --suggest (once every suggest_requested finding carries decision.suggested); the Tomo-Editor sets it true when the user requests suggestions. EXCLUDED from emit_digest (an editor/Tomo signal, not an apply edit). Optional — absent is treated as false for back-compat. Pass-2 also refuses to apply a doc while pending (also detected from the markdown for .md-only users).

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this wire was produced.

run_id.description: Stable run identifier joining the report and wire.

emit_digest.description: SHA-256 over the APPLY-decision fields only (per finding: id + decision.{selected,repoint,replace,file_under}). Recomputed and compared in Pass-2 to detect USER apply edits. Tomo-generated candidates, the suggested ran-marker, suggest_requested, top-level approved, top-level suggest_pending, and read-only detail are EXCLUDED — so --suggest writing candidates never flips this. Hashi carries emit_digest back VERBATIM; a mismatch (or approved:true) means the JSON is authoritative.

findings.description: All findings, severity-ordered (integrity → structure → advisory). Each fixable finding carries a 'decision' block the user can edit; advisory findings omit 'decision'.

id.description: Stable finding identifier (e.g. F01). Joins the markdown report to the wire.

fixable.description: True for checks 1-4 (unparented,orphan,broken_up,dead_link). False for advisory checks 5-6.

target.description: The primary note this finding targets.

detail.description: Per-check detail. Fields vary by check type (read-only in the wire).

candidate_mocs.description: unparented/orphan: scored MOC candidates from orphan_link.

up_target.description: broken_up: the broken up:: target stem.

dead_target.description: dead_link: the unresolved wikilink target text.

count.description: dead_link: how many times the dead link appears.

dupes.description: duplicate_stem: list of paths sharing the stem.

mtime.description: stale_moc: last-modified ISO timestamp from listDir.

decision.description: Editable block — present ONLY on fixable findings (fixable=true). Absent for advisory. The user edits 'selected' to accept or skip the fix; Pass-2 reads this field alone.

selected.description: Editable — true to apply the fix. Pre-set from finding.decision.selected in the doc.

action.description: Proposed action name (e.g. link_to_moc, edit_note_text, add_relationship). Null when not yet determined.

replace.description: dead_link only — editable replacement target (e.g. '[[New Note]]'). Empty string = remove intent. Absent on all other check types.

repoint.description: broken_up only — editable repoint target (e.g. '[[Correct MOC]]'). Non-empty repoints up:: to the chosen MOC (add_relationship); empty string = remove the broken line. Absent on all other check types.

file_under.description: unparented/orphan only — editable filing target MOC (e.g. '[[000 Home MOC]]' or a bare stem). Parallels repoint/replace. An explicit value ALWAYS wins over detail.candidate_mocs[0]; empty string = fall back to the scan candidate (or skip if none). Absent on all other check types. Included in the apply-decision digest.

candidates.description: DISPLAY-ONLY scored LLM candidates the Tomo-Editor renders for picking. Empty at first render; populated by '/garden-audit --suggest' for findings selected via a markdown Suggest tick or decision.suggest_requested. NEVER auto-applied — only the value the editor commits into repoint/replace/file_under is read by Pass-2. EXCLUDED from emit_digest (Tomo-generated, not a user edit).

suggest_requested.description: The Tomo-Editor sets this true to mark a finding that wants LLM candidates; '/garden-audit --suggest' enriches those (union with the markdown Suggest ticks). EXCLUDED from emit_digest (an editor signal, not a user apply edit).

suggested.description: Set true by '/garden-audit --suggest' on every finding it processed — distinguishes ran-and-empty (suggested:true, candidates:[]) from awaiting-run (suggest_requested:true, no suggested). Cleared on findings not requested in the latest run. EXCLUDED from emit_digest (Tomo-generated, not a user edit). Absent = never ran.
